[!dolt] skip
# Test bd list filtering and JSON output
bd init --prefix test --quiet
bd create 'Open task' --description 'Open work item' --type task --priority 2 --json
extractid OPEN
bd create 'Closed task' --description 'Already done' --type task --priority 3 --json
extractid CLOSED
bd close $CLOSED --reason 'Done'

bd list --json
jq 'length'
stdout '^1$'
jq '.[0].title'
stdout '"Open task"'

bd list --status all --json
jq 'length'
stdout '^2$'

bd list --status closed
stdout 'Closed task'
